description: This file contains R functions for interacting with the SparkR backend, including methods for calling Java methods, creating objects, removing objects, and handling errors. It facilitates communication between R and Java components in Spark.

methods.name: isInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a given Java object is an instance of a specified class.

methods.name: callJMethod
methods.description: Calls a Java method on a specified object.

methods.name: callJStatic
methods.description: Calls a static Java method on a specified class.

methods.name: newJObject
methods.description: Creates a new Java object of a specified class.

methods.name: removeJObject
methods.description: Removes a Java object from the SparkR backend.

methods.name: invokeJava
methods.description: Invokes a Java method on the SparkR backend, handling communication and errors.
